V3-REQ-A.remaining_gap: The specification waves repair the S1/S6 edge and include HMAC/request/child nodes. Most consumer rows still use schematic ABI/export and producer descriptions rather than complete typed consumed interfaces; V1 fallback also inherits a newly imposed root workload guard.

V3-REQ-B.remaining_gap: W2/W8 are frame-local, positional/compaction Rebase are distinguished and the C1 shortcut is removed. Compaction must retain the newly selected witness subspan as well as original packet spans, and the carried three-form text must agree. RQ-1 does not establish original operation-by-operation acceptance or cost equivalence.

V3-REQ-C.remaining_gap: P3 scope and non-claims now agree. The exact-rational Decimal_Value intermediate has no explicit lexical-sign channel for accepted negative zero, and Repr remains an external CPython definition. Authentic selection/currentness is still an open premise; compromise exclusions and rollback-detection overstatement cannot discharge the original target.

V3-REQ-D.remaining_gap: AO-1..AO-11 and unselected G improve the comparison and correctly reject F. The matrix admits that no option satisfies all obligations; qualitative cost labels and ledger checkmarks do not complete kind/amount/rollover/physical/native-cost correspondence. D-4a cannot authorize a weaker target.

V3-REQ-E.remaining_gap: Launch ordering, measurement relay and native sub-helper redecision improve the design. READY followed by a disagreement ABORT violates the exclusive pair. The blanket worker-owned condition excludes collector finalization, and complete command material, C ABI and authority-preserving surfaces remain unfinished.

V3-REQ-F.remaining_gap: Subject-kind replay and mutation choke points improve the proposal. The carried root graph still mixes request/drain and root transitions, root r1 excludes the newly permitted prelaunch release, r6 is written as an invariant instead of a barrier check, and M8(c) lacks an original job/unit authorization correspondence. The DDL cannot encode all new native fields/modes/quantities as specified.

V3-REQ-G.remaining_gap: The inactive-unit condition is removed and the handoff seed no longer requires HANDLER_TERMINAL. Never_Launched release is permitted in r3 but no coherent root-product release/return route is supplied. Complete restart recovery still depends on descriptor/escrow survival and serving authority not supplied by the tables.

V3-REQ-H.remaining_gap: Armed intervals detect uncertainty and duplicate writers are distinguished. Reattachment enables a reader before ARMED, READ interval detection is underspecified after chunk records, and front-crash/restart rows claim recovery of process-local pipe copies. Durable P/W cannot recreate an absent pipe or its consumed bytes.

V3-REQ-I.remaining_gap: Request Transfer_Join no longer requires its future intake and PID/user namespaces are separated. RELAY framing, per-gate response/request/generation binding and costs are unspecified, optional presence is internally inconsistent, the root ACK path is conflated with already-worker-owned request joins, and all own/historical gate modes are not supplied.

V3-REQ-J.remaining_gap: Tool keys, provisioner paths and explicit migration alternatives are supplied. Empty-genesis head references an absent events row under the retained foreign-key setting, genesis raw bytes versus archive representation are conflated, new State fields have no exact DDL/fold encoding, and plan-v1 migration needs an explicit changed-path/exclusive-create mapping.

V3-REQ-K.remaining_gap: Define an explicit effective joined checkview for the owning On-unit roster, qualified scope attribution and appended layout/tile sets while retaining every CAPI base-table byte. CAPI5's carried qualifier check tests each routine prefix for membership in CAPI_SPARK_UNITS, and V4 adds RW_ROUTINE_NAMES but supplies no explicit corresponding effective owning-unit map; derive it from a reviewed enrolled RW unit roster, not from the candidate name alone. Repair MQ-RW2's stimulus/expected relation without narrowing any existing qualified/gate rule or C-API row.

V3-REQ-L.remaining_gap: The dedicated lane is withdrawn and router waits leave the lock. The progress table lists new custody/UNKNOWN/collection waits but does not show original accepted response progress when the owner or its physical evidence never becomes available. M8(c) is not a proved substitute; RELAY and executor/storage dependencies remain incomplete.

findings_assessment.NF4-1: VERIFIED_STATIC_CONDITIONAL: After launch returns an owned object, the root exception branch stops/retains and does not itself call original quarantine; with owned None it does quarantine. EFFECT_INTENT lacks the serial DISPATCH_INTENT boundary. This is static control flow, not proof that all dispatched failures take that branch. Consequence: V4-B.5 must preserve exception order, durable dispatch boundary and original quarantine. A custody failure must not make those actions impossible while the use remains RESERVED.
findings_assessment.NF4-2: VERIFIED_STATIC_ROUTING_CONSEQUENCE_QUALIFIED: Every selected non-owner invocation routes to RootWorkerFront when attached; the listed workload operations are refused/quarantined by the serial path. The root path has no corresponding workload guard. This supports the selected invocation-path observation, not a whole-program proof that no scoped launch exists elsewhere. Consequence: Restoring the serial guard corrects DF-3 but would refuse workload operations on the draft's only selected non-owner route. It cannot count as preserving all original required accepted workload cases.
findings_assessment.NF4-3: VERIFIED_STATIC_RETAINED_SEED_NOT_RECOVERY_PROOF: The retained intent includes root_native and original_native_use; the referenced EXECUTION_NATIVE includes material, observation and provenance. Worker current capture requires that exact root_native event and ROOT_READY_CONJUNCTION. The abbreviated :105-109 reference is protected_root_observation.py, not protected_root_worker.py. Consequence: V4-G.3 can reconstruct a seed before HANDLER_TERMINAL, but authentic current physical/closure evidence and legal settlement still require separate evidence.
findings_assessment.NF4-4: VERIFIED_STATIC_FULL_PATH_MAPPING_SCOPE: Every maps line with a pathname beginning '/' is source checked with INTERPRETER/EXECUTABLE/EXTENSION/DATA roles, without an execute-permission filter; exe has INTERPRETER/EXECUTABLE roles. Consequence: R4-3/R4-23 correctly restore the original file-backed mapping scope. NC-P3 exclusions must remain explicit; subset coverage is not proof that no unlisted dynamically executed bytes exist.
findings_assessment.NF4-5: VERIFIED_STATIC_ABSENCE_IN_SELECTED_SOURCE: The only selected-source occurrence of initial_event is the exact genesis key set. No selected producer/consumer was found. Absence is limited to that source tree. Consequence: Defining v2 initial_event null is justified, but the empty-chain head must be consistent with the carried DDL foreign key and native origin representation.
findings_assessment.NF4-6: VERIFIED_STATIC_RELATIVE_KEY_AND_PREFIX_LIMIT: The issuer key is selected beneath descriptor authority_root, and head MAC covers head plus genesis. A self-consistent retained prefix and its head have no external monotonic comparison in this loader. Consequence: V4-C.2 correctly limits self-MAC authenticity and all-history rollback. Boundary cross-reference checks detect only rollback behind references retained elsewhere, not every valid earlier prefix.
findings_assessment.NF4-7: VERIFIED_STATIC_TOOL_SELECTION: The stated exact native_components keys and tool lookups/value membership are present. Consequence: R4-16/R4-37 and V4-J.2 correctly enumerate the selected tools without replacing v1 command-name/which semantics. Provisioning and runtime resolution remain OPEN.
findings_assessment.NF4-8: VERIFIED_STATIC_ORIGINAL_JOB_CANCEL: job.cancel is mutating; validates a world string, reads world and active_jobs_for_world, raises NO_ACTIVE_JOB for an empty set, and calls runner.cancel once for each recorded job/unit. Consequence: The source supports custody-owner store access and original job-unit stopping. It does not itself authorize the new M8(c) generation-root stop without equivalent world/job/unit and current authorization evidence.
findings_assessment.NF4-9: VERIFIED_STATIC_EXPLICIT_HELPER_FD_FLOW_RUNTIME_COMPLETENESS_OPEN: The helpers' created pipes/socketpairs are CLOEXEC; explicit actor stdio is dup2'd, and V1 additionally clears CLOEXEC on its custody sender and appends its descriptor number. V3 sends the measurement receiver to the owner and closes its local receiver without reading that frame. An exhaustive actual inherited-FD roster is not established by these lexical excerpts alone. Consequence: A changed relaying sub-helper can enforce COMMIT_CHILD only with its own authenticated material/native decision, cost/source/privilege coverage, and fixed event ordering. The READY-then-ABORT contradiction remains.
findings_assessment.NF4-10: VERIFIED_STATIC_EXCEPTION_BOUNDARY: recover_committed at EFFECT_OBSERVED/SETTLED and EFFECT_INTENT+RESULT_CAPTURE is outside the branch try handlers. Broker/owner/K4 recovery catches WorldlineError into unresolved. Consequence: R4-53 and RT-21/RT-22 correctly preserve that startup exception boundary; new recovery must not reinterpret the original refusal as successful settlement.
findings_assessment.NF4-11: VERIFIED_STATIC_STATUS_MUTATION: status is registered mutating; a dirty store with a reconciler triggers recapture. WorldlineError is reported as degraded status, with store meta updates. Consequence: V4-L must preserve genuine status semantics and original dependencies, while demonstrating that its added handoff/UNKNOWN/queue waits do not remove responsiveness.
findings_assessment.NF4-12: VERIFIED_STATIC_SCOPED_LAUNCH_ORDER: RECORD_LAUNCH_INTENT precedes DISPATCH_INTENT and systemd dispatch; RECORD_RUNNING follows accept_held. Consequence: R4-59/R4-61 correctly repair E3/E6 ordering. Helper READY commit and native gates remain separate open integration obligations.
findings_assessment.NF4-13: VERIFIED_STATIC_DDL_KIND_OMISSION_REPAIR: The carried graph includes FRONT_RECONSTRUCTION -> FRONT_OWNED(g+1), and v3's event-kind CHECK lacked FRONT_OWNED. R4-29 adds it. Consequence: The event-kind omission is repaired; the product transition, owner projection, native encoding and complete DDL-to-Next correspondence still require a precise mapping.

Qualitative decision/process cost labels and ledger checkmarks do not close full native or enforcement correspondence.

required_changes.change: Provide one consistent CHILD_READY/CHILD_ABORT commit protocol with native sub-helper agreement before an authorizing exclusive decision and before actor exec. The blanket WORKER_OWNED requirement also excludes the collector named for terminal settlement. Native self-decision improves enforcement but adds unproved native ABI/cost surface.

Reconcile R4-48's capture-failure ABANDON requirement with M8(a)'s handoff-window qualifier; preserve the original pre-handoff failure stop and define a legal pre-transfer handoff abort. Supply replay recovery for committed intents whose effects or responses are pending. For M8(c), establish the original current request/world/active-job/unit authorization, error and cancellation correspondence before permitting a front generation-root stop.

ABANDON only originates in transfer phases, while R4-48 and M8(a) give different capture-failure scopes. A ROOT_STOP_INTENT is not authorization; original job.cancel cancels recorded active job units after store checks.

Retain the corrected original outer barrier and seed reconstruction without HANDLER_TERMINAL. Specify all RT-21 through RT-27 recovery actions with authentic closure/current material, immutable first committed result and original fatal-versus-unresolved exception mapping.
required_changes.reason: r3' permits a valid no-launch release but r1 and the carried graph do not admit the resulting state or return. The retained seed and new recovery rows are useful inputs, not a complete reconstruction path, especially after descriptor or serving-owner loss.

required_changes.change: Make each front/worker/host crash row consistent with actual surviving descriptor custody.
